# The scanner behind the Semgrep merge gate (.github/workflows/security.yml), and nothing else.
#
# In a file of its own rather than in the workflow's install command, because a version written
# into a `run:` step is one Dependabot cannot see, and the pip entry in .github/dependabot.yml reads
# this file to propose the next one. The pin stays exact: a scanner that updates itself changes the
# gate's verdict without anybody changing the code. A proposal for a newer version is a proposal to
# measure again, as security.yml says above the install step, not one to merge as it stands.
#
# Installed only on a runner and never shipped, which is why the licence gate leaves this file out
# (CI_ONLY_MANIFESTS in .github/scripts/dependency_gate.py).
semgrep==1.183.0
